max_word = 0
parenthesis_words = 0

last_letter = False
current_count = 0

for ch in document:

        in_paren = True
        last_letter = False
        current_count = 0
    elif ch == ')':
        in_paren = False
        last_letter = False
        current_count = 0
    elif ch.isalpha():
        if in_paren and not last_letter:
            parenthesis_words += 1
        elif not in_paren:
            current_count += 1
            if current_count > max_word:
                max_word = current_count
        last_letter = True
    else:
        last_letter = False
        current_count = 0

print(max_word, parenthesis_words)
